description: Global pipeline agents — role definitions for context→asset retrieval / raw intake→visual intent→CAD→audit→repair→delivery→learning. No Python in agents/; execution via core/.

main_agent_identity.mission: classify request, build task contract, dispatch responsible agents, and block unsupported completion claims

model_bridge_expansion.principle: Use the 5.5 model bridge as a read-only judgment and learning layer wherever advanced visual, semantic, delivery, asset, repair, or training judgment is needed. Do not use it to execute CAD, delete, save DWG, promote table C, or replace readback evidence.

automaticGrowthContract.evidenceBoundary: Learning updates Agent memory, prompt addenda, shared prompt rules, checker candidates, and retest targets; it does not promote table C, asset verified status, CAD geometry proof, or user acceptance.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Judge user-visible CAD quality: text readability, mojibake, overlap, clipping, alignment, intent match, visual polish, and reusable-output likelihood.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn recurring visible failures and convert them into prompt/checker/repair lessons.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review whether final claims are supported by evidence and whether the user can be asked to review.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn over-claiming, missing-evidence, and premature-completion patterns.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Propose local repair only, targeting handles or bbox with proposal_only execution policy.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn local repair patterns and avoid whole-modelspace cleanup or side-by-side redraws.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review dispatch plan, required agents, risk assessment, missing gates, and completion-claim blockers.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn missed-dispatch, missing-hard-gate, and weak-task-contract patterns.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Act as the professional designer judgment layer: identify drawing type, expression purpose, design intent, constraints, downstream agents, and open questions before CAD_PLAN.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn professional design-brief interpretation, missed design purpose, and wrong task-dispatch patterns.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Decide whether to waive style generation, generate one auto-selectable style, or generate 2-3 parameterized candidates with rationale when multi-option comparison is explicitly needed.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn successful and failed style parameterization: size, proportion, text hierarchy, line spacing, color/layer strategy, density, and candidate selection.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review whether the output looks like a professional drawing and matches the design strategy, selected style candidate, industry habit, and user-visible purpose.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn design critique, contextual user-choice routing, and creative-output failure patterns without treating A/B/C as a mandatory template.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Split visual references into semantic parts, proportions, hierarchy, style constraints, and forbidden simplifications.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn visual decomposition errors before CAD_PLAN is generated.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Check whether intent is sufficiently explicit and whether assumptions are safe.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn ambiguity, missing dimension/source, and dangerous assumption patterns.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Detect cases where machine green checks hide visible or semantic failures.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Promote recurring visual or semantic failures into stronger audit/checker candidates.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Advise on source boundary, clean reusable source, quarantine, metadata-only state, and child-agent dispatch.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn contamination, weak sourceSpec, and premature verified-claim patterns.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review native DWG layout plan, clean/proof separation, slot readability, and expansion space before/after CAD write.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn layout density, source/proof separation, and shelf readability corrections.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Judge warehouse layout readability, aisle clarity, density, source/proof separation, layer semantics, and retrieval path.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn visual warehouse failure patterns and repair recommendations.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review whether context pack is stale, noisy, missing prior feedback, or using invalid handles.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn context drift and missed-evidence recovery patterns.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review retrieval match strength and prevent weak matches from becoming CAD proof.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn wrong-asset, weak-match, and retrieval-overclaim patterns.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review classification stability, naming, retrieval tags, lifecycle state, and conflict handling.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn asset taxonomy, duplicate conflict, and retrieval metadata improvements.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review whether reuse evidence is plan-only, ready probe, or real replay with created handles/readback.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn failed reuse and unsupported asset_reused claim patterns.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review what should become memory, prompt delta, checker candidate, base rule, task rule, or retest target.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn to turn errors into durable Agent growth instead of only recording pass/fail.

agentJudgmentNodes.modelRole: Review execution plan risk only; never output CAD commands or execution authorization.
agentJudgmentNodes.learningTarget: Learn risky CAD_PLAN patterns before write while leaving execution to deterministic code.

sceneAndTrainingNodes.modelRole: Review whether the designer agent actually learned the lesson and what should flow back to training.
sceneAndTrainingNodes.learningTarget: Learn design common sense, CAD foundation weaknesses, and retest requirements.

sceneAndTrainingNodes.modelRole: Review residential common sense such as orientation, circulation, furniture semantics, visual quality, and practical scale.
sceneAndTrainingNodes.learningTarget: Learn residential scenario failures without implementing CAD execution in the scene layer.

sceneAndTrainingNodes.modelRole: Review commercial-fitout common sense when this paused scene is reactivated.
sceneAndTrainingNodes.learningTarget: Learn scenario vocabulary and failure examples only.

sceneAndTrainingNodes.modelRole: Review office common sense when this paused scene is reactivated.
sceneAndTrainingNodes.learningTarget: Learn scenario vocabulary and failure examples only.

sceneAndTrainingNodes.modelRole: Review restaurant common sense when this paused scene is reactivated.
sceneAndTrainingNodes.learningTarget: Learn scenario vocabulary and failure examples only.

sceneAndTrainingNodes.modelRole: Review exhibition common sense when this paused scene is reactivated.
sceneAndTrainingNodes.learningTarget: Learn scenario vocabulary and failure examples only.

sceneAndTrainingNodes.modelRole: Review healthcare common sense when this paused scene is reactivated.
sceneAndTrainingNodes.learningTarget: Learn scenario vocabulary and failure examples only.

sceneAndTrainingNodes.modelRole: Review whether custom project constraints are preserved instead of overwritten by defaults.
sceneAndTrainingNodes.learningTarget: Learn custom-project rule preservation without promoting unreviewed global rules.

scene_plugins.description: Scene agents supply vocabulary only; mounted by pipeline_intent and checklist defaults.

forbidden_patterns.probe_drives_styling: Do not use read_block_layout_profile to choose component shapes.
forbidden_patterns.machine_green_delivery: Machine audit pass alone must not request user acceptance.
forbidden_patterns.style_match_without_target: Reference-match work requires a style_target or explicit user waiver.
forbidden_patterns.design_stage_skipped: Creative or style-sensitive CAD work must not jump from scene brief directly to CAD_PLAN without design_strategy or an explicit low-risk waiver.
forbidden_patterns.template_style_without_design_reasoning: Do not generate new size/style output by copying a fixed template without drawing type, expression purpose, styleDecision, candidate parameters or waiver reason, and selection rationale.
forbidden_patterns.design_review_skipped: Do not request user acceptance for style-sensitive output without design review or an explicit reason why design review is not applicable.
forbidden_patterns.split_as_backrest: Split lines must not replace semantic back cushions.
forbidden_patterns.sofa_direction_semantics_inverted: For sofa plan references, do not invert the hard back, soft back cushion, and seat cushion order.
forbidden_patterns.duplicate_shared_edges: Adjacent parts may touch, but the same CAD segment must not be emitted twice.
forbidden_patterns.clone_reference_fragments: Do not clone fragmented supplier geometry when a semantic redraw is requested.
forbidden_patterns.size_only_repair_loop: Visual failures must not be repaired by size-only changes.
forbidden_patterns.retrieval_hit_as_capability: Retrieval or catalog hit is an upstream contract, not proof that CAD geometry is correct.
forbidden_patterns.intake_table_required: When the user provides a folder and a rough description, scan and infer first; do not ask the user to fill a table.
forbidden_patterns.raw_library_promoted: Raw standard CAD libraries stay reference_only until a separate promotion gate creates schema, lineage, checks, and evidence_boundary.
forbidden_patterns.silent_bbox_fallback: When assets are weak or missing, enter exploration/deferred mode; do not silently draw a blank bbox as the object.
forbidden_patterns.training_canvas_as_asset_library: Do not copy a training panel, title block, note, border, dimension, or evidence text into the clean reusable system asset source area.
forbidden_patterns.untracked_agent_derivation: When asset governance needs a new global Agent, record a reviewed-package requirement instead of silently inventing an untracked role.
forbidden_patterns.screenshot_captured_as_visual_layout_pas: Do not treat a captured or nonblank screenshot as visual layout acceptance without the visual_layout_review hard gate.
forbidden_patterns.model_review_as_cad_proof: Do not treat modelBackedReview=pass as CAD geometry proof, asset source proof, reuse proof, or permission to skip readback and rule gates.
forbidden_patterns.model_visual_acceptance_as_user_acceptan: Do not treat modelBackedVisualAcceptance=pass as user acceptance, CAD geometry proof, or permission to skip readback and repair gates.
forbidden_patterns.model_asset_governor_override: Do not let modelAssistedDecision override source boundary, clean source, readback, reuse, save, or verified-status rule gates.
forbidden_patterns.model_repair_executes_cad: Model-backed repair plans must remain proposal_only and must not execute CAD commands, delete broad scopes, or save DWG files.
forbidden_patterns.model_bridge_skipped_for_quota: In accuracy-first mode, do not skip a registered 5.5 model-bridge judgment node only to save quota; record provider unavailability instead of pretending the review passed.
forbidden_patterns.model_bridge_learning_omitted: A model-backed or model-assisted Agent failure must produce a learningCandidate or an explicit not_required decision; do not lose error patterns after review.
forbidden_patterns.model_execute_authorizes_cad: The execute Agent may use the model bridge only as a plan guard; model output must never authorize CAD execution, deletion, saving, or formal-layer edits.
forbidden_patterns.unregistered_agent_activated: The main Agent must not activate or require an Agent absent from pipeline_manifest.json; record it as a reviewed-package or OpenSpec candidate.
forbidden_patterns.self_check_free_completion_claim: High-risk orchestration must not claim completion without mainAgentSelfCheck and dispatchDecision evidence.
